steps.title: Week 0 — Paper trade.
steps.body: Run on a demo for 2–4 weeks. Goal: see at least one losing streak comparable to the backtest's max drawdown.

steps.title: Week 1–2 — 5% live.
steps.body: Real money, but tiny. Cost discovery only — confirm slippage and commission match your model.

steps.title: Week 3–4 — 50% size.
steps.body: Half intended size. Confirm win rate and R:R hold up at meaningful position sizes.

steps.title: Week 5+ — Full deployment.
steps.body: Intended size, kill criteria written and active. Calendar reminder for monthly review.

steps.title: Kill criteria.
steps.body: 3 consecutive losing weeks → pause. Drawdown > 1.5× backtested max → stop. Slippage doubles vs. trial → broker conditions changed.
